parent_session.reason: v02's first broad interior mantle deformation was independently rejected and exactly rolled back. v03 begins from that recovered mesh as an artist-prepared, one-region leading-mantle repair.

candidate.role: immutable raw topology retained beside the v01/v02 reviewed working surface; never likeness authority or runtime input

primary_trace.role: sole primary-view likeness, silhouette and landmark authority

artist_region.intent: Replace the generated C-loop impression with one heavy, thick attached leading shell, descending from the first dorsal chamber into a grounded front drape. The silhouette may be corrected only by sculpting a coherent volume, never by pulling a broad field of interior vertices toward a curve.
primary_checks: The leading shell has a broad diagonal outer contour and reaches the source ground line.
The attachment reads as a heavy overlap beneath the first dorsal sac, not as a cut ribbon.
The result preserves negative space beneath the body without becoming a detached curtain.
diagnostic_checks: The mantle retains visible thickness in front and elevated-rear views.
No new opening, folded strip, detached component or hidden self-intersection appears.

topology_policy.starting_mesh: the exact v02 recovered working mesh, the original hidden immutable v05 raw mesh and all historical evidence
allowed: local face deletion, creation and merge on the existing working surface
local retopology of an existing semantic region

passes.region: the existing leading-mantle surface and its dorsal attachment, prepared by the named leading_mantle_v03 vertex groups
passes.primary_goal: make the leading mantle read as one broad diagonal attached shell from the first dorsal mass to the source ground line, using a coherent volume rather than a field deformation
passes.diagnostic_goal: retain a thick coherent mantle surface and the existing body volume without new openings, torn strips or detached forms
passes.authoring_requirement: A visible Blender artist must inspect the prepared scene and use sculpt/edit tools on collector_v05_direct_working. The controlled bridge may prepare, audit and validate the pass but may not automate the dominant-mass deformation.

review_gate.before_each_pass: the declared predecessor must have a local audit receipt and a recorded independent continue decision; the continuation baseline is a reviewed audit-only receipt
review_gate.after_each_pass: capture primary, silhouette, trace, opposite, front, side and elevated-rear frames; an independent reviewer records continue or rollback before another session may begin
review_gate.acceptance: literal primary overlay and normal visual review are mandatory; scalar metrics diagnose only and cannot accept or rank the mesh
